source: Fabric SQL analytics endpoint; current visible bronze and silver tables
limitation: Endpoint synchronization and upstream source freshness are not certified by these queries.

checks.name: sage_ar.header_keys
checks.query:
SELECT invoice_uid FROM cd_silver_sage_ar_invoices
GROUP BY invoice_uid HAVING invoice_uid IS NULL OR COUNT(*) > 1

checks.name: sage_ar.line_keys
checks.query:
SELECT line_uid FROM cd_silver_sage_ar_lines
GROUP BY line_uid HAVING line_uid IS NULL OR COUNT(*) > 1

checks.name: sage_ar.orphan_lines
checks.query:
SELECT l.* FROM cd_silver_sage_ar_lines l
LEFT JOIN cd_silver_sage_ar_invoices h ON l.invoice_uid = h.invoice_uid
WHERE h.invoice_uid IS NULL

checks.name: sage_ar.headers_row_conservation
checks.query:
SELECT b.n AS bronze_rows, s.n AS silver_rows
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM [CD_Bronze_Lakehouse].[dbo].cd_bronze_sage_acrinv) b
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cd_silver_sage_ar_invoices) s
WHERE b.n <> s.n

checks.name: sage_ar.lines_row_conservation
checks.query:
SELECT b.n AS bronze_rows, s.n AS silver_rows
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM [CD_Bronze_Lakehouse].[dbo].cd_bronze_sage_arivln) b
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cd_silver_sage_ar_lines) s
WHERE b.n <> s.n

checks.name: sage_ar.invoice_line_amounts
checks.query:
SELECT h.invoice_uid, h.invoice_id, h.invoice_total,
       l.line_count, l.known_amounts, l.line_total,
       h.invoice_total - l.line_total AS difference
FROM cd_silver_sage_ar_invoices h
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT invoice_uid, COUNT(*) AS line_count, COUNT(line_total) AS known_amounts,
           SUM(line_total) AS line_total
    FROM cd_silver_sage_ar_lines GROUP BY invoice_uid
) l ON h.invoice_uid = l.invoice_uid
WHERE h.invoice_total IS NULL OR l.line_count IS NULL
   OR l.known_amounts <> l.line_count
   OR ABS(h.invoice_total - l.line_total) > 0.01
